questions.text: Consider the given Assertion and Reason. Choose the correct option. Assertion (A): FastText produces word embeddings of variable size, depending on the number of subword n-grams a word contains. Reason (R): FastText computes the final embedding for a word by summing or averaging the embeddings of its subword n-grams.
options: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, and (R) is the correct explanation of (A).
Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A).
Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.
Assertion (A) is false, and Reason (R) is false.

questions.text: Which of the following statements is/are INCORRECT?
options: Recurrent neural networks can handle a sequence of arbitrary length, while feedforward neural networks can not.
Training recurrent neural networks is hard because of vanishing and exploding gradient problems.
Gradient clipping is an effective way of solving vanishing gradient problem.
Gated recurrent units (GRUs) have fewer parameters than LSTMs
questions.correct_answer: Gradient clipping is an effective way of solving vanishing gradient problem.

questions.text: In an LSTM network, each gate has a specific function. Which of the following statements about the functions of LSTM gates is INCORRECT?
options: The forget gate decides which information from the cell state should be discarded.
The input gate determines what new information to add to the cell state.
The output gate decides which part of the input sequence is passed to the cell state.
The forget gate helps prevent the accumulation of irrelevant information in the cell state.
questions.correct_answer: The output gate decides which part of the input sequence is passed to the cell state.

questions.text: You are comparing rule-based machine translation (RBMT), statistical machine translation(SMT), and example-based machine translation (EBMT) for translating a set of sentences between English and Spanish. Based on the characteristics of these techniques, which of the following statements are correct?
options: RBMT heavily relies on linguistic resources such as bilingual dictionaries and grammar rules, making it less effective for low-resource language pairs.
EBMT does not rely on explicit linguistic rules but instead retrieves and reuses translation examples, making it highly dependent on the quality of the example database.
RBMT has a strong ability to generalize to unseen inputs due to its reliance on manually crafted linguistic rules.
SMT can handle unseen words better than RBMT by leveraging subword-level probabilities for translation.
EBMT achieves higher translation accuracy than SMT in domain-specific scenarios if the example database contains relevant matches.
correct_answer: RBMT heavily relies on linguistic resources such as bilingual dictionaries and grammar rules, making it less effective for low-resource language pairs.
EBMT does not rely on explicit linguistic rules but instead retrieves and reuses translation examples, making it highly dependent on the quality of the example database.
EBMT achieves higher translation accuracy than SMT in domain-specific scenarios if the example database contains relevant matches.

questions.text: In positional encoding for a transformer model, why are sine and cosine functions used for encoding positions?
options: To ensure that the position of each token is represented uniquely with periodic functions.
To represent positional embeddings in a way that scales linearly with sequence length.
To allow the model to generalize to unseen sequence lengths using the periodic nature of sine and cosine.
To reduce the number of parameters required for positional representations compared to learnable embeddings.
correct_answer: To ensure that the position of each token is represented uniquely with periodic functions.
To allow the model to generalize to unseen sequence lengths using the periodic nature of sine and cosine.

questions.text: What happens if you increase the number of attention heads in a transformer model while keeping the embedding size constant?
options: Each head's dimensionality decreases.
The computational complexity of the attention mechanism decreases.
The model learns more diverse relationships in the input sequence.
The model processes longer sequences without truncation.
correct_answer: The model learns more diverse relationships in the input sequence.

questions.text: Which of the following is/are INCORRECT?:
options: One-shot learning allows a model to correctly make predictions after seeing only a single example of the task.
Zero-shot learning adapts a model without any task-specific training, relying on its ability to generalize from pre-trained knowledge.
One-shot learning requires training the model with a single example from a new task to make predictions for similar cases.
Zero-shot learning requires the model to have seen examples from the task it is asked to perform.
correct_answer: One-shot learning requires training the model with a single example from a new task to make predictions for similar cases.
Zero-shot learning requires the model to have seen examples from the task it is asked to perform.
